title: Draft social posts about each feature you ship
summary: A developer built a free Claude Code plugin that finds what they shipped and saves X and LinkedIn drafts in their voice to a post scheduler for approval.
agent_role: The agent checks recent work to find what was shipped, then writes post drafts in the author's voice and saves them to a scheduling tool. The human approves every post.
what_they_did: A developer wanted to post about every feature they shipped but kept putting it off. They built a free Claude Code plugin for this. It finds what was shipped and writes X and LinkedIn drafts in their voice. The drafts are saved to a post scheduling tool, Publer or Postiz.
worth_knowing: Nothing gets posted on its own. The author says you approve everything before it goes out.
prompt: Look at the work I finished in [project folder] over the last [time period]. List the features I shipped in plain words. For each one, draft a short X post and a LinkedIn post in my voice. Use [links to a few of my past posts] as style examples. Save the drafts to [scheduling tool] as drafts only. Show me the list first and wait for my approval. Never publish anything yourself.

curation.rationale: A real workflow: Claude Code looks at what was shipped and drafts social posts for approval. The post is short, with no results or detail beyond the idea.
